title: cotylelobium burckii
intro: Cotylelobium burckii, commonly known as the Burck's ironwood or ironwood tree, is a species of plant in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Cotylelobium burckii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal properties.
